info.about: Castlevania Legends is a 1997 action-platform game developed and released by Konami for the Game Boy. The third Castlevania game released for the system, the story follows Sonia Belmont, a vampire hunter battling the first incarnation of Count Dracula.
info.why: A March 1998 release at the end of the Game Boy's life that Konami left out of the 2019 Anniversary Collection, so demand falls on the original print run.
